title: Robin Ki Hood
style: Phonk-infused hyper-speed heist rap with breakneck dembow-like bounce, clipped percussion, and looping sinister bass; verse rides frantic chase imagery, pre-chorus tightens with whispered count-offs and crowd shouts, chorus slams with gang vocals on the anchor phrase. Male vocals with doubled hooks, ad-lib pings, short delay throws on key words, tape-stop flips, siren risers, and glitchy mirror swells. Bright-crisp, punchy, and aggressive with a dusty underground edge., rock, fake, bounce
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver, plan on lock
Delta alpha, fast as shock
Mansion se seedha, break the gate
Cage ko todke, change the fate

Heres my boys, sab on cue
Thrash this toy, and split in two
Police chatter, corner ke paas
Sirens sound, but we move past

Unit 336, name in smoke
Ek fake break, then vanish, लोक
Extra stripe, no rage, no fuss
Right lane leke, trust the rush

[Pre-Chorus]
Math Driver, 3 Mirrors, go
Phonk track bounce, low and slow
Hyper speed, I can, you got this
We believe, ab kaun sa miss?

[Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

cash back drop, what a shock
chase and cage, we crack the block
free birds rock, no chain, no fear
robin in hood, we outta here

[Verse 2]
thrash this toy, phir turn around
sneaky phonk, thrift drift sound
give them rage in our cage tonight
but our wing got room toाइट

Math Driver, the architect
Plan ka dream, fully connect
Done safe, done sound, no trace, no loss
Mansion ka map, we cross that boss

a robin a robin out of the mansion
fake a break, then switch the motion
bust em like we should, ha bro, if we could
you heard the sarg, we misunderstood

[Pre-Chorus]
Math Driver, G4, lift
Pedals everywhere, quick quick shift
Delta track, DJ Zyn Rose
Sabke pairon mein runaway flows

[Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

cash back drop, what a shock
chase and cage, we crack the block
free birds rock, no chain, no fear
robin in hood, we outta here

[Bridge]
Sand box city, eyes full of sand
where are my toys, who made this land?
bored stare, like we care, go
ground hog day, but we still roll

but i forget what 8 is for
Math driver, VDS Mansion, door to door
No way back, we go to stay
escape this place, then fade away

[Final Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

cash back drop, what a shock
chase and cage, we crack the block
free birds rock, no chain, no fear
robin in hood, we outta here

V D S mansion, party for me
V D S mansion, party for me
hyperspeed, you got this boy
our robin, our robin, our robin in our hood
